Markets.title: IT crash ahead? CLSA downgrades TCS, Infosys, Wipro, other stocks; revises target prices. Here's why
Markets.summary: Brokerage firm CLSA downgraded major Indian IT stocks, including TCS, Infosys, and Wipro, while reducing their target prices due to ongoing artificial intelligence concerns. Despite this caution on large-cap firms, the brokerage maintained a positive outlook on select mid-tier IT companies.

Markets.title: Gold extends losses, falls to nearly Rs 1.54 lakh/10 gm. Time to buy?
Markets.summary: Gold prices dropped on the MCX to nearly Rs 1.54 lakh per 10 grams while rising internationally due to easing Treasury yields. Despite pressures from higher oil prices and inflation concerns, experts view this correction as a buying opportunity.

Markets.title: RailTel Corporation shares rally 5% after bagging Rs 166.8 crore EPFO order
Markets.summary: RailTel shares rose nearly 5% after securing a Rs 166.80 crore one-year contract extension from the EPFO. Despite this revenue boost and increased foreign institutional holding, the stock's technical indicators remain weak as it trades below all monitored simple moving averages.

Markets.title: High Treasury yields put US fiscal outlook under spotlight
Markets.summary: High U.S. Treasury yields are increasing the costs required to refinance government debt and fund future deficits. This trend raises concerns in Washington over the growing expense of servicing the national debt.

Markets.title: US housing market weakens as AI boom drives factory output
Markets.summary: US single-family homebuilding dropped to a 3.5-year low in July due to high mortgage rates and economic uncertainty. Meanwhile, factory output increased as strong investments in AI drove demand for semiconductors and high-tech equipment.

Markets.title: D-Street’s CAS turmoil clouds BSE’s growth outlook
Markets.summary: BSE shares fell significantly this month following the launch of a new closing auction session on August third. The resulting drop in trading volumes and options activity has prompted analysts to downgrade their outlook on the stock amid new funding rules and possible fee changes.

Geo-Political.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine's recently dismissed defense minister is advocating for a presidential election. Elections in the country have been suspended since martial law was enacted in February 2022.

Geo-Political.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada and says countries close to a deal
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump delayed imposing new tariffs on Canadian goods for three days. The temporary pause allows the two countries more time to finalize an ongoing trade agreement.

Geo-Political.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, US court hears
Geo-Political.summary: A trial has begun in a major lawsuit brought by US states accusing Meta of intentionally hooking children on Facebook and Instagram. In its defense, Meta argued that social media addiction does not exist.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
Geo-Political.summary: South Korea has shortened its joint military exercises with the United States. The decision follows President Trump's announcement to curtail these drills due to his favorable relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

Geo-Political.title: Husband and mother-in-law charged over Indian bride's death
Geo-Political.summary: Five months after her wedding, Indian model and actor Twisha Sharma was found dead in May. Her husband and mother-in-law have now been charged in connection with her death.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil's President Lula hails oil discovery near Amazon river
Geo-Political.summary: Brazilian President Lula has praised a new oil discovery in the sea off the mouth of the Amazon river. Environmentalists have strongly criticized this exploratory drilling activity.

AI & Tech.summary: An author tested getting organic traffic from ChatGPT by asking it to recommend a SaaS development course. The AI recommended the author's course as the top result without any paid advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits? Unpacking the economics of India's toll landscape, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highway Management Company shows how high-traffic routes and FASTag passes generate highway revenue. The report also highlights changing trends in private sector investment across India's toll roads.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's GDP growth estimate for the 2027 fiscal year to 6.8%. However, ongoing downside risks include the West Asia war, high headline inflation, a depreciating currency, and weaker-than-expected capital expenditure.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is accelerating agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes. This strategy aims to counteract the negative economic impacts of El Nino and a weak monsoon on the rural economy.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research expects India's balance of payments to reach a $50 billion surplus in fiscal year 2027. This financial growth is being driven by strong foreign currency inflows into the country.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: The Southwest Monsoon's cumulative rainfall deficit has narrowed to 13 percent. However, severe regional imbalances remain hidden beneath erratic swings between intense deluges and prolonged dry spells.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The government is considering eliminating performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) awarded government contracts. Currently, MSMEs receiving orders over ₹100,000 must provide a bank guarantee worth 3% to 10% of the project's value.

India.title: 9 Bangladeshi Nationals Killed In Kolkata Hotel Fire, AC Blast Suspected
India.summary: A fire in a Kolkata hotel killed nine Bangladeshi nationals. Authorities suspect an air-conditioner explosion caused the fire, though the exact cause remains unconfirmed.

India.title: NTA Removes 600 Experts, Introduces Four-Tier Question Paper Checking System
India.summary: The National Testing Agency removed 600 experts following recent controversies and criticisms. It also introduced a new four-tier system to better scrutinize question papers and reduce errors.

India.title: "Our Action Was Correct": Tukaram Munde On Rs 5 Lakh Fine On Pune Sweet Shop
India.summary: Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration Commissioner Tukaram Munde defended a food safety action after the Bombay High Court ordered compensation for a Pune sweet shop. Munde maintained that the decision to levy a Rs 5 lakh fine on the establishment was correct.

India.title: Jharkhand Government Releases list Of 44 Recruitment Exams Cancelled Due To Irregularities
India.summary: The Jharkhand government has cancelled 44 recruitment exams held since 2014 following allegations of irregularities. This decision comes in response to ongoing protests by students in the state.

India.title: Madhya Pradesh Students Made To Drink Urine, Principal Says 'Eat Chocolate To Feel Better'
India.summary: A student in Madhya Pradesh mixed urine into a water bottle and tricked classmates into drinking it. When the victims reported the incident, the school principal dismissed their complaints and told them to eat chocolate to feel better.

India.title: Bidesh Sikhya Bruti 2026: Odisha Launches Overseas Scholarship For SC, ST Students
India.summary: The Odisha government has launched the Bidesh Sikhya Bruti 2026 scholarship to help SC and ST students pursue postgraduate and PhD studies abroad. This financial support program aims to increase international higher education opportunities for eligible students from the state.

General.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
General.summary: Ukraine's recently dismissed defense minister has called for the country to hold a presidential election. Elections in Ukraine are currently suspended because martial law has been in effect since February 2022.

General.title: Three dead after family get into difficulty in sea
General.summary: A man, a woman, and a teenage girl died after getting into difficulty while swimming off the Sussex coast in Shoreham. Another young girl was rescued and remains in critical condition.

General.title: 'Everyone in for Christmas' - Burnham unveils rough sleeping plan
General.summary: Andy Burnham has announced a new plan to offer housing to all rough sleepers in England. This initiative is being compared to the "Everyone In" program implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic.

General.title: Demand for degree apprenticeships in England quadruples in three years
General.summary: Demand for degree apprenticeships in England has quadrupled over the past three years. This surge in popularity comes as university costs face increased scrutiny.
